scenarios.scenario: Surface — Identify signing failure from binlog

rubricScores.criterion: Identified the MSB3073 error from the signing step
Mentioned that the signing tool failed with an access/permission error
Identified the specific file that failed to sign (e.g. StorageLibrary.dll or similar DLL)
Mentioned the SignCopiedFiles or signing target involved

scenarios.reasoning: The agent correctly identified the high-level failure (MSB3073 in SignCopiedFiles for DataSources.csproj) and the general error message ('PRS Signing Failed on one of signing batches'). However, it failed to identify the specific file(s) that caused the failure and did not clearly identify the nature of the error as an access/permission issue. The agent made many search attempts (36 tool calls) but couldn't drill down to the specific root cause details, suggesting inefficiency in its investigation approach.
